description: Compromised package versions. Every set is derived from an Apache-2.0 dataset and records it in "dataset" (repository, commit, licence); see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the attribution and the changes made. The 2025-11 set is Datadog's consolidated_iocs.csv as published, reshaped to name -> versions. Every other set holds the versions that the vendor report in "source" lists and that an OpenSSF malicious-packages record also lists; "records" names those records (OSV ids) per package and "unmatched" the listed versions no record lists, which are not loaded. Every entry inherits its set's source. Generated by scripts/import-package-sets.mjs, never edited by hand. A loaded version later found to be listed in error stays in its set and is dropped by the loader through "exclusions", each with the evidence and the date it was checked.
